import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr5 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0005.png').convert('RGB'))
print('obs5 left wall floor edge:')
for col in range(120, 220, 10):
    floor = (arr5[:, col, 0] > 100) & (arr5[:, col, 0] < 200) & (arr5[:, col, 1] > 100) & (arr5[:, col, 1] < 200)
    floor_y = np.where(floor)[0][0] if np.any(floor) else None
    if floor_y:
        scale = 1.55 * 256 / (floor_y - 255.5)
        # obs 5 was facing -x (turn 270)
        # camera forward is -x, camera right is +y, camera left is -y
        # col < 256 is to the left (-y)
        # y_offset = (col - 255.5) / 256 * scale
        print(f'col {col}: floor_y={floor_y}, y={scale * (col - 255.5) / 256}')
"
